test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tokenizer_text (ascii String, cjk String, mixed String) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE tokenizer_index_asciiCJK (text String, INDEX idx text TYPE text(tokenizer = asciiCJK)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE tokenizer_index_asciiCJK_v2 (text String, INDEX idx text TYPE text(tokenizer = asciiCJK_v2)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tokenizer_text WITH ['the', 'quick', 'brown', 'fox', 'ClickHouse', 'user_id', '3.14', 'don''t', 'e-mail', 'café', 'naïve', 'Москва'] AS ascii_words, ['中', '文', '分', '词', '数', '据', '库', '，', '。', 'テキスト', 'ひ', '한국어'] AS cjk_words SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> ascii_words[rand(number * 60 + x) % 12 + 1], range(40)), ' '), arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> cjk_words[rand(number * 60 + x) % 12 + 1], range(80)), ''), arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> if(x % 2 = 0, ascii_words, cjk_words)[rand(number * 60 + x) % 12 + 1], range(60)), ' ') FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tokenizer_text WHERE NOT ignore(tokens({text}, '{tokenizer}'))
SELECT count() FROM tokenizer_text WHERE NOT ignore(tokensForLikePattern(concat('%', {text}, '%'), '{tokenizer}'))
INSERT INTO tokenizer_index_{tokenizer} SELECT mixed FROM tokenizer_text
